reviewStandard: Six deterministic disposition-revise records are re-audited against current controlled authorities and their latest literal failures. Every prior source remains immutable and non-public. Exactly one independent call at the stated new revision is permitted per hash-frozen prompt, followed by native-resolution literal-output, prohibited-content, strict safe-field, crop, alpha/opacity, and exact-hash audit.
promotionRule: Only a new-revision output matching its frozen identity, representation boundary, fully opaque flat pale field, exact object counts, and centered 835 by 484 source-safe area may proceed to separate exact-hash Control Tower acceptance. Every prior source remains immutable, rejected, and non-public.
